about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Who I Am
about.description: I am a Junior Full-Stack .NET & Angular Developer and an ITI intensive Full-Stack Web Development graduate with a Computer Science degree. I have a deep interest in software architecture and clean code practices (SOLID, DRY). I specialize in designing scalable RESTful APIs with Clean/Onion architectures, leveraging ASP.NET Core, EF Core, and CQRS, and building rich, responsive frontend experiences using Angular Standalone components, Signals, and RxJS.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.description: Explore my latest work and creative solutions

project1.title: Smart Home E-Commerce (Graduation Project)
project1.description: A comprehensive smart home e-commerce platform with real-time device monitoring. Implemented Clean Architecture backend in ASP.NET Core, CQRS via MediatR, SQL Server, and an Angular client using Signals.

project2.title: Enterprise E-Commerce Backend
project2.description: A high-performance RESTful API using Onion Architecture. Features include generic repository pattern, JWT authentication, AutoMapper, validation using FluentValidation, and Serilog logging.

project3.title: Restaurant Ordering Platform
project3.description: An interactive ordering system. Features real-time state tracking using SignalR, dynamic shopping cart management, RxJS state management, and a responsive frontend.

project4.title: Smart Hospital Management
project4.description: A system managing medical records, appointment scheduling, and doctor-patient communication built with ASP.NET Core Web API and Angular Material dashboard.

project5.title: Talabat Clone
project5.description: A responsive food delivery frontend clone showcasing complex form validation, interactive filters, and stateful cart logic in Angular.
